verdict.rationale: Fly.io emphasizes that it runs standard container/VM primitives and that 'The API you start with is the API you keep' (no rearchitecting or migration required as you scale), which implies avoidance of proprietary lock-in, but there is no direct evidence that code written for Fly.io runs unmodified on other edge platforms (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy) or that Fly exposes standard runtime/storage APIs portable across providers. Missing for 10: explicit cross-platform portability claims, evidence of standard API compliance (e.g., WinterCG/Web APIs), and independent confirmation that apps built on Fly run elsewhere without modification.
